title: Electrical Service
description: Complete electrical installation, maintenance, and testing services for commercial, industrial, and residential projects.
details: Our electrical services cover design, installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical systems including HT/LT panels, transformers, cable laying, and distribution boards.

title: HVAC Service
description: Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems design, installation, and maintenance for optimal climate control.
details: We provide comprehensive HVAC solutions including central air conditioning, chilled water systems, VRV/VRF systems, and air handling units.

title: Plumbing
description: Complete plumbing solutions including water supply, drainage, sanitary, and rainwater harvesting systems.
details: Our plumbing services encompass design and installation of internal and external plumbing, sewage systems, and water treatment plants.

title: Fire Fighting
description: Advanced fire protection systems including sprinklers, hydrants, and fire alarm networks for comprehensive safety.
details: We install and maintain fire sprinkler systems, hydrant systems, fire pumps, detection systems, and emergency lighting.

title: All ELV System
description: Extra Low Voltage systems including access control, public address, and building management systems.
details: Our ELV solutions cover structured cabling, access control, intercom, CCTV, PA systems, and building automation.

title: CCTV Service
description: High-definition surveillance systems with remote monitoring and intelligent video analytics capabilities.
details: We design and install IP-based CCTV systems with HD cameras, network video recorders, and advanced analytics.

title: Networking
description: Structured cabling and network infrastructure for seamless data connectivity and communication.
details: Complete networking solutions including Cat 6/Cat 6A cabling, fiber optics, network racks, and wireless infrastructure.

title: Fire Alarm System
description: Intelligent fire detection and alarm systems with addressable technology for early warning and safety.
details: We install addressable fire alarm panels, smoke detectors, heat detectors, manual call points, and hooters.

title: PA System
description: Public Address systems for clear communication in large venues, campuses, and commercial spaces.
details: Our PA systems include amplifiers, speakers, microphones, and zoning controls for effective audio distribution.
